name: Micro-content
description: Provides a lightweight reusable content-entity and type that supports fields, revisions and translation.

suggests.drupal/backfill_formatter: Formatter to display a fallback/backfill value for empty microcontent references

project_description:
Back to top 

 Overview 
 Micro-content module provides a light-weight reusable content entity that you can use in your layouts and entity-reference fields.

 Back to top 

 Features 
 
 Supports adding bundles 
 Supports adding fields 
 Supports reuse 
 Revisionable 
 Quickedit integration 
 Works with Entity browser straight out of the box - works best with this patch applied. 
 
 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 Just Drupal core.

 Back to top 

 Known problems 
 None at present - but please use the issue queue to report any issues.

 Back to top 

 Tutorials 
 Coming soon

 Back to top 

 Credits 
 Written by Lee Rowlands for one of PreviousNext 's clients.

 Back to top 

 Recommended modules 
 
 Entity browser with [#2765295] applied. 
 Micro-content revision ui 
 
 Back to top 

 Similar projects 
 
 Block content module in core is similar, but for every content entity, it creates a new block plugin which can fast choke up your block plugin defintions, it also has a fairly restricted access/permission module 
 Paragraphs - however paragraphs are not re-usable by design without paragraphs library module 
 Efforts in core [#2704331]
